rationale: Price sits at 51.7% of today's range after a breakout above yesterday's high ($143.00 vs $141.80) was fully rejected with a ~4% giveback, leaving trapped longs as overhead supply between 140-143 — which argues against a long. But the short side is equally unattractive: the last 25 minutes show a steady higher-low grind that has reclaimed session VWAP ($137.31) with price above the 9-EMA, on a day the broad market is up ~1%. With two consecutive days of wide, mean-reverting chop, no trend resolution, a 26 bp spread, and thin late-day 5m volume, the midpoint of the range offers no mechanical edge in either direction.
